steps.title: Remove PHP/MySQL Backend Code
steps.description: Clean up and remove legacy PHP script documentation, backend credentials, and HTTP request logic for MySQL integrations.

steps.title: Implement Local SQLite Database Helper
steps.description: Create a local DatabaseHelper class inside MainActivity extending SQLiteOpenHelper to maintain the 'appointments' schema natively.

steps.title: Define SQLite Structure & Fields
steps.description: Configure database columns for name, age, phone, department, doctor, date, time, status, and created_at timestamps.

steps.title: Upgrade AI Model to Gemini 2.5 Flash
steps.description: Update API calls to utilize Google Gemini 2.5 Flash as the processing engine for conversation and metadata synthesis.

steps.title: Build Parameterized SQLite Insertion Logic
steps.description: Deploy parameterized SQLite queries via ContentValues to secure local insert operations and prevent query vulnerabilities.

steps.title: Enhance Admin Tab Layout with Search Control
steps.description: Add layout search inputs and dynamic action button to filter appointments locally in real-time.

steps.title: Remove Legacy Backend URL Input
steps.description: Purge remote URL fields from activity_main.xml and clean configuration UI for clean local operations.

steps.title: Implement Admin Search Filter Queries
steps.description: Write parameterized database reading functions using SQL LIKE patterns to search by patient name, phone, or department.

steps.title: Add Interactive Appointment Details View
steps.description: Render a modern AlertDialog containing full detail breakdown when clicking any appointment item in the Admin list.

steps.title: Integrate Status and Deletion Management
steps.description: Implement quick drop-down status selection updates and deletion workflows directly in the detail dialog to modify database records.

steps.title: Verify Speech Voice Feedback Systems
steps.description: Ensure TextToSpeech voice outputs and speech input listeners work robustly with modern Gemini 2.5 response outputs.

steps.title: Building Hospital AI Booker
steps.description: Compile the app natively with Android SDK 34 and Gradle 8.5 verifying correct behavior and local SQLite stability.
